title: When the Atlas Falls
author: Noor Eastwick
blurb: Orsen Sandoval, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
